{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-czzh","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: Binary .rlib build artifact committed to git","description":"## Issue

`rust/librust_out.rlib` (6562 bytes) was committed at the repo root level. This is a compiled Rust library binary artifact that must never be tracked in git.

## Severity

P0 — binary blobs in version control bloat the repo, break diff tools, and indicate a broken build workflow.

## Required Fix

1. Remove the file from the index: `git rm --cached rust/librust_out.rlib`
2. Add `*.rlib` (or `rust/*.rlib`) to `.gitignore`
3. Amend the commit to exclude it

## Notes

The repo's `.gitignore` already has `rust/target/` but this `.rlib` was placed at `rust/librust_out.rlib` — outside the target directory.
